## Overview

::: {.callout-warning title="Current reporting result — computationally sound, interval crosses zero"}
The corrected 2026-08-09 `reporting` fit uses 53 children and passes the automatic computational gate. The natural indirect contrast is +0.292 blending items (89% interval −0.098 to +0.761; P>0 = 0.888), and the total is +0.748 (−0.056 to +1.560; P>0 = 0.932). The separately fitted t3 sensitivity is similarly inconclusive: indirect +0.263 items (−0.144 to +0.747; P>0 = 0.854) and total +0.385 (−0.447 to +1.222; P>0 = 0.772). The primary and t3 indirect intervals already include zero before any session-dose shift, while power scaling flags several parameters. These are model-based decompositions under unresolved confounding and same-wave assumptions, not identified causal routes; clean convergence does not change that limitation.
:::

LRP87 is the downstream link in the phonological chain (#228 item 12): the companion to [LRP59](https://github.com/dseinternational/language-reading-predictors/blob/main/docs/models/lrp-rli-med-059/index.qmd) (word reading via letter-sounds) and [LRP86](https://github.com/dseinternational/language-reading-predictors/tree/main/docs/models/lrp-rli-med-086) (nonword reading via letter-sounds), decomposing the intervention's effect on **phoneme blending** ($B$) into the part transmitted by raising letter-sound knowledge $L$ (NIE) and the direct/residual part (NDE). Together the three trace the code route through its intermediate (blending) and terminal (nonword decoding) outcomes — both previously visible only as associations (mech-072/172).

Blending is graded (~4% floored, 10 items), so this is a standard graded Beta-Binomial mediation, identical in structure to LRP59 with the outcome swapped: phase 0 only (`phase_mode="itt"`, t1 → t2 — the randomised window; $G = 2 - \text{group}$, positive = intervention helps), mediator $M = L_{t2}$ (conditioned on $L_{t1}$), outcome $Y = B_{t2}$ (conditioned on $B_{t1}$), with a $G \times M$ interaction; NDE/NIE on the items scale by counterfactual simulation from the posterior.

## Assumptions — read this first

The full mediation-assumption treatment (randomisation handles $G\to Y$/$G\to M$; the binding unverifiable assumption is no unmeasured $L\to B$ confounding; the dose-`IS` exposure-induced-confounder non-identification; the contemporaneous $L_{t2}$/$B_{t2}$ same-wave caveat) is as in [LRP59](https://github.com/dseinternational/language-reading-predictors/blob/main/docs/models/lrp-rli-med-059/index.qmd) — read it there. A **model-based g-formula decomposition under stated (cross-world) assumptions, not an identified natural effect**; wide at $n \approx 53$.

**Shared session dose.** Intervention sessions $IS$ (`attend`) are a treatment-induced common cause of the mediator and outcome ($IS \to L$ and $IS \to PA$); following the family precedent they are **not** conditioned on, so **shared session dose is a plausible inflator of the NIE via $L$**. The results now locate an observed/fitted IS-strength scenario on the NIE sensitivity surface; this quantifies the caveat but does not repair identification.

**Natural versus interventional estimand.** [MED-187](https://github.com/dseinternational/language-reading-predictors/tree/main/docs/models/lrp-rli-med-187) is the parent+100 interventional companion: the same joint model and adjustment set, but IDE/IIE replace the cross-world NDE/NIE. In this implementation its IIE should match this model's NIE up to sampling and g-formula Monte Carlo error because both use the same fitted covariate-conditional mediator law. That agreement is an implementation check, not evidence that shared dose is harmless; latent general ability still prevents an identified causal mediation reading.

_Adjustment set — corrected (2026-08-08), mediation criterion._ Under the current lagged DAG the measured $L \to B$ confounders include age $A$, hearing $HS$ (`hs`), speech production $SP$ (`deapp_c`) and baseline word reading $WR_1$ through $LS_2 \leftarrow WR_1 \to PA_2$, plus the baseline $L_{t1}$ and the outcome own-baseline $B_{t1}$. Bare `W` denotes the distinct $WR_1$ confounder; `W_pre` remains the structural marker that resolves to $B_{t1}$. **Phonological memory ($RW$) considered and excluded — precision-only:** it is a parent of blending but not of letter sounds, and the route $L \leftarrow HS \to RW \to B$ is blocked at adjusted $HS$. **Intervention sessions $IS$ (`attend`) confirmed NOT adjusted:** $L \leftarrow IS \to B$ is a treatment-affected recanting witness, so conditioning on it would change the estimand and can open the latent-general-ability collider. MED-187 supplies the interventional estimand; #324 supplies the named-confounder calibration. $E$/$R$ remain legitimately absent. Adding $WR_1$ reduces an observable backdoor but does not identify the decomposition.
